description: NEER: Hurricane Laura Reconnaissance is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "field recon", published or maintained by Britt Raubenheimer, Woods Hole Oceanographic Institution (whoi.edu). Hurricane Laura made landfall in Cameron Parish, LA early on August 27, 2020 as a category 4 Hurricane with minimum pressure of 937 mbar, winds up to 150 mph, and surge of more than 10 feet. The NEER Association supported a Field Team in response to this event. Coverage: Cameron, LA. DesignSafe files it as a "field recon" project. Keywords: Louisiana, Hurricane Laura, NEER, Reconnaissance, waves, water levels. Published 2020-09-20. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
